tests.report:
Feature: Confirming the first train starts its calibration
Expected: The dialog now asks the user to place the second train ('Bahn 2') on the calibration point
Observed failure: After clicking 'Bahn 1 steht auf dem Kalibrierpunkt' calibration began (Bahn 1 speed 60, 40 cm/s). After the 20-second wait the dialog still said 'Bahn 1 wird kalibriert … bitte warten.' Only about 29 s after the click did it show 'Bitte stelle Bahn 2 auf den Kalibrierpunkt.' with the confirm button. The flow works but exceeds the specified wait.
Steps completed before failure: 3

Feature: Trains never occupy the same place
Expected: In none of the screenshots do the markers of 'Bahn 1' and 'Bahn 2' overlap or stand on the same track section; one train waits or evades while the other passes
Observed failure: Setup and Start worked (Bahn 1: Haltestelle 1 → 2; Bahn 2: Haltestelle 2 → 1). In 4 screenshots taken about 0/12/24/28 s after Start, the markers never overlapped. They did share track sections: at about 12 s Bahn 2 was close behind Bahn 1 on the stretch leading to Haltestelle 1, and at about 24 s and 28 s Bahn 2 drove along the top straight toward Haltestelle 2 while Bahn 1 stood there. No train waited or evaded; all switches stayed 'gerade'.
Steps completed before failure: 11

Feature: Stops are driven in a loop
Expected: 'Bahn 1' is seen at stop A, later at stop B and later again at stop A (a detour to the calibration point in between is allowed); it does not stay at stop B
Observed failure: Setup gave A = Haltestelle 1 and B = Haltestelle 2 for both trains; Start set the badge to 'In Fahrt'. Bahn 1 in the track screenshots: t≈0 at Haltestelle 1 (A); ≈30 s on the lower inner track by Weiche 3 heading toward the calibration branch; ≈58 s back at Haltestelle 1 (A); ≈85 s on the lower inner track between Haltestelle 3 and Weiche 3. Bahn 1 was never seen at Haltestelle 2 (B); it moved back and forth between A and the lower track. Bahn 2 stayed at Weiche 2 with speed 0 the whole time.
Steps completed before failure: 13
